scaffoldParams.title: make feature parameters
scaffoldParams.nameDesc: Feature key. Creates src/features/<name>/, route /<name>, and locale key nav.<name>. Use lowercase kebab-case (e.g. inventory).
scaffoldParams.labelDesc: English sidebar label. Written to src/locales/en.json under nav.*. Shown when the app locale is English.
scaffoldParams.labelIdDesc: Indonesian sidebar label. Written to src/locales/id.json under nav.*. Shown when the app locale is Indonesian. If omitted, label is used for both.
scaffoldParams.scopeDesc: What to generate: full (default) = page + table + store + usecase · store = page + table + store · page = empty page + menu wiring only.

preview.featureDescription: This is the Inventory page scaffolded by make feature name=inventory label="Inventory" label-id="Inventaris". Follow the Tutorial tab to create it yourself.
preview.localeNote: Tutorial UI strings live in src/features/tutorial/locales/ (like Storybook). Feature strings live in src/locales/.

logo.title: Change the logo
logo.description: Replace the two SVG files in public/ and point app.config.ts to them. The header switches automatically between light and dark variants.
logo.bullets: Replace public/logo-light.svg for light theme|Replace public/logo-dark.svg for dark theme|Update title, description.en, description.id, and logo paths in src/config/app.config.ts|HeaderLogo shows description based on active locale

guideLogo.title: Customize app branding
guideLogo.description: Replace the default logo and set your app title and descriptions in app.config.ts. The header switches between light and dark variants automatically.
guideLogo.bullets: Replace public/logo-light.svg for light theme|Replace public/logo-dark.svg for dark theme|Update title, description.en, description.id, and logo paths in src/config/app.config.ts|HeaderLogo shows description based on active locale

localization.title: Localization (i18n)
localization.description: Add UI strings in src/locales/en.json and id.json. Use useLocale() with t('key', params?) in components. Use {{param}} placeholders in JSON when a string needs dynamic values.

steps.addKeys: Add keys in src/locales/en.json and id.json (same structure in both files)
steps.callT: Call t with the key and params object
steps.paramOrder: EN and ID can place {{params}} in different positions, but param names must match
steps.useStore: Import useLocale from @/locales/localeStore and get t in your Vue component in your component

scaffold.title: Scaffold with make feature (shortcut)
scaffold.description: Fastest way to add an Inventory page: one command wires the page, sidebar menu, route, and locale.

menu.title: Add menu manually (optional)
menu.description: Wire the Inventory page into navigation and routing by hand. Complete step 2 first so InventoryPage.vue exists.
menu.skipNote: Already used make feature in step 1? Skip steps 2 and 3, open

steps.navLocale: Add nav label and subtitle in src/locales/en.json and id.json
steps.sidebarMenu: Register the item in src/layouts/sidebar/featureMenuItemsGenerate.ts (or featureMenuItems.ts for manual-only)
steps.router: Add the lazy route in src/router/featureRoutesGenerate.ts (or featureRoutes.ts for manual-only)
steps.sidebarIcon: Optional: custom icon in SidebarIcons.ts, then swap icon in featureMenuItemsGenerate.ts

feature.title: Create feature code manually (optional)
feature.description: Complete standard code for an Inventory feature if you are not using the generator. Follow the folder structure, then copy each file in order.
feature.continueNote: When the feature files are in place, continue to step 3 for locale keys, sidebar menu, and route wiring.
feature.skipNote: Already used make feature in step 1? Skip steps 2 and 3, open

steps.page: InventoryPage.vue: title, subtitle, and table component
steps.table: InventoryTable.vue: DataTable with columns and pagination
steps.usecase: inventoryUsecase.ts: mock data with delay, returns PaginatedResult

mockData.title: Mock data (default)
mockData.description: Generated features ship with mock data inside the usecase file. No backend or .env is required to develop UI flows end-to-end.
mockData.realApiNote: Want to connect a real backend instead? Continue to

steps.usecase: make feature puts mock data in usecase/*.ts
steps.usersReference: See Users feature for full CRUD with drawers

realApi.title: Connect a real API (optional)
realApi.description: When your backend is ready, wire the Inventory feature to a live endpoint: set the base URL, define API response types, map them to domain types, then call apiSource from the usecase.
realApi.skipNote: Still using mock data from step 4? Open

steps.env: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL in .env (default) or override in .env.development / .env.production per mode.
steps.response: Add ApiInventoryItemResponse in src/models/model.response.ts (snake_case, matches backend JSON)
steps.type: Add InventoryItem in src/models/model.type.ts (camelCase, used by store and table)
steps.mapper: Add toInventoryItem and toPaginatedInventory in src/models/model.map.ts
steps.apiSource: Add getInventory() in src/datasource/network/apiSource.ts, returns raw API response
steps.usecase: inventoryUsecase calls apiSource.getInventory() and maps with toPaginatedInventory. Store and page stay unchanged

environment.title: Environment (development & production)
environment.description: VITE_* variables live in .env by default; .env.development and .env.production override per mode when needed.

steps.twoFiles: .env holds defaults for all modes. .env.development (make dev) and .env.production (make build) only override vars that differ per mode.
steps.development: Development: local API, Documentation & Components menu enabled
steps.production: Production: live API server, set dev feature flags for your deploy
steps.apiUrl: VITE_API_BASE_URL: different endpoint per mode. Use a local backend in dev and your live server URL in production
steps.devFeatures: VITE_SHOW_DEV_FEATURES: show or hide Documentation & Components menu
steps.scrollToTop: VITE_ENABLE_SCROLL_TO_TOP: scroll-to-top button on all pages (defaults to true)
